style_en: Miniature diorama 3D CG render placed in an empty white space. Figures are smooth faceless figurines (no eyes, nose or mouth details), told apart by clothing, hairstyle and props. Soft shadows, slightly high camera angle looking down. Mostly white and gray, only the key objects in red. The robbers' helicopter is always the same small light helicopter with a white body, a gray belly and a red stripe along the side, with no registration letters, no logo and no markings. Police helicopters are always plain dark blue with no markings and no text. The cash depot is always the same large plain gray concrete building with a flat roof and one glass pyramid skylight in the middle of the roof, no signs. Police officers always wear plain dark navy uniforms with no insignia, no badges and no text. Show only the objects and people named in the scene, all set in 2009; no extra props from other eras, no year plaque, no caption plate.
avoid_en: logos, brand names, readable text or numbers, flags, police insignia, registration letters on aircraft, car badges, license plate text, blood, wounds, injured people, guns being aimed or fired, faces resembling real people, year plaques, caption plates

robbers.desc_en: robbers, men figurines with smooth featureless faces wearing plain black long-sleeved clothes, plain black full-face masks with no markings, black gloves, holding no visible weapons

police.desc_en: police officers, figurines with smooth featureless faces in plain dark navy uniforms and plain navy caps with no insignia, no badges and no text

staff.desc_en: depot staff, figurines with smooth featureless faces in plain light gray work uniforms with no logo

investigators.desc_en: investigators, figurines with smooth featureless faces in plain white coveralls with hoods and white gloves, no text

pilot.desc_en: the pilot, a man in his mid 30s as a miniature 3D figurine with a smooth featureless face, short light brown hair, plain dark gray zip jacket with no print, dark jeans
